faqs.question: How much does a website cost?
faqs.answer: Most of our websites fall between ₹15,000 and ₹75,000 depending on complexity. We always give you a fixed quote before starting — no hidden costs, no hourly billing surprises.

faqs.question: How long does a project take?
faqs.answer: A standard website takes 2–4 weeks from discovery call to launch. Apps take 4–8 weeks. We'll confirm a firm timeline during the strategy phase.

faqs.question: Do you work with clients outside Madurai?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We work with clients across India and internationally. Everything is managed through video calls, WhatsApp, and email — distance is never a blocker.

faqs.question: Will I own the code and design files?
faqs.answer: Yes. Once the final payment is made, you own 100% of the code, design files, and all assets we create for you. No lock-in, no licensing fees.

faqs.question: What if I need changes after launch?
faqs.answer: Every project includes 30 days of free post-launch support. After that, we offer affordable maintenance plans or one-off change requests.

faqs.question: Do you do hosting and domain setup?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can handle domain registration, hosting setup, SSL certificates, and deployment. We recommend and set up the most cost-effective options for your needs.
